title: NIST SSDF 1.1
passage_paraphrase: Defines risk-based security criteria, review/testing evidence, secure release preservation and vulnerability response.
limitations: Outcome guidance; not a universal command list or certification. Exact tasks cross-checked in final PDF.

title: NIST SSDF 1.2 draft
passage_paraphrase: The current retrieved revision page still labels 1.2 an initial public draft.
limitations: Do not substitute draft identifiers for final 1.1 mappings.

title: OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 requirements
passage_paraphrase: Selected requirements cover contextual output, safe queries/process calls, spreadsheet exports, SSRF, validation, transactions, resource limits, text rendering, paths, sessions, authorization, TLS, network inventory and redacted errors.
limitations: Tailored subset only. No ASVS level or whole-standard conformance asserted.

title: OWASP ASVS overview
passage_paraphrase: Use version-qualified identifiers because numbering changes between releases.
limitations: Overview is not execution evidence.

title: OWASP WSTG 4.2
version_or_status: Stable alias resolved to v4.2 on access
passage_paraphrase: Test authentication, authorization, sessions, input handling, errors and client behavior with versioned procedures.
limitations: Test techniques require target authorization and application adaptation.

title: OWASP SAMM version 2 model
passage_paraphrase: Security work spans the lifecycle and operations rather than one last scan.
limitations: Organization maturity model; no mandate to reach maximum maturity.

title: OWASP SAMM Security Testing
locator: Scalable Baseline and Deep Understanding streams
passage_paraphrase: Automated baselines and risk-focused manual investigation complement each other.
limitations: Expert investigation costs more and should follow risk and recent change.

title: OpenSSF Scorecard check documentation
version_or_status: Rolling main observed 2026-10-23; no immutable revision captured
locator: Code-Review, CI-Tests, Dangerous-Workflow, Token-Permissions, Pinned-Dependencies, SAST
passage_paraphrase: Automated repository heuristics have coverage and permission limits; AI reviews do not count as human Code-Review for Scorecard.
limitations: Optional diagnostic, not a release score threshold. No Scorecard run performed.

title: OpenSSF Best Practices passing criteria
passage_paraphrase: Unique release identity, meaningful release notes, automated tests and vulnerability handling support maintainability.
limitations: Badge requirements apply to badge claims; public-source requirements do not authorize making this repo public.

title: SLSA 1.2 specification
passage_paraphrase: Supply-chain assurance can improve incrementally and provenance is distinct from correctness.
limitations: No SLSA certification or level claim made.

title: SLSA 1.2 Build Track Basics
passage_paraphrase: L1 records build provenance; L2 adds hosted signed provenance; L3 hardens the platform.
limitations: A hand-written receipt or hashes alone establish neither L2 nor L3.

title: REUSE specification 3.3
passage_paraphrase: Associate file-level rights information using headers, adjacent .license files or reviewed REUSE.toml annotations; include used license texts.
limitations: REUSE is a convention. Adding metadata does not prove ownership or grant rights.

title: SPDX MIT license text
passage_paraphrase: Redistributed copies or substantial portions retain applicable copyright and permission notices.
limitations: Actual distribution obligations depend on all included licenses and facts; rights-holder confirmation remains open.

title: GitHub Actions secure use
locator: Least privilege, script injection, third-party actions
passage_paraphrase: Minimize workflow authority, isolate untrusted input/code and pin third-party action revisions.
limitations: Do not provision integrations or widen credentials just to make a gate green.

title: GitHub sensitive-data removal
locator: Exposure response and history rewrite effects
passage_paraphrase: Revoking exposed credentials and dealing with historical copies are separate from removing a current file; history rewrites have coordination costs.
limitations: Research grants no rotation, deletion or history rewrite authority.

title: GitHub immutable releases
passage_paraphrase: Immutable release assets and their tag are protected; prepare assets in a draft before publication; release metadata remains partly editable.
limitations: Optional hosting control requiring a separate owner decision; not enabled by this task.

title: CPython development cycle
passage_paraphrase: Feature freeze narrows work; RC fixes receive core-team review; stability takes priority.
limitations: Core-team staffing and branch policy are not imposed on ARGELLAN.

title: CPython PEP 101
passage_paraphrase: Release managers verify source identity, blockers, clean source tarball builds, platform artifacts and post-upload downloads.
limitations: Process evolves: do not copy older GPG instructions universally; 3.14+ differs.

title: Apache HTTP Server release guidelines
locator: Release Manager; candidate testing; roll procedure
passage_paraphrase: Candidate revision, package tests, generated documentation, checksums/signatures and release decision are explicit.
limitations: Three PMC votes are Apache governance; suggested production soak is not a universal requirement.

title: SQLite testing practice
version_or_status: Live document; quoted scale anchored to 3.42.0 in source
passage_paraphrase: Multiple test methods include failure injection, crash recovery, boundary cases, fuzzing and release checks.
limitations: Database-engine scale and coverage targets do not transfer to a small observer.

title: Google SRE Release Engineering
passage_paraphrase: Repeatable builds use known inputs and build identities; release authority and rollout/rollback are explicit.
limitations: Historical Google practice, not proof of Google's current internal implementation.

title: SQLite Online Backup API
locator: Using Online Backup API; error handling
passage_paraphrase: A supported snapshot method avoids treating an arbitrary copy of an active database as a coherent backup.
limitations: Application restore semantics and multi-database consistency still require testing.
